title: AAPS 3.4.0.0 crashes on start with tidepool plugin enabled and no mainstream browser
body:
I just build and installed AAPS 3.4.0.0 and it instantly crashed all the time.

I asked AI the logs and asked for the reason and it pointed me towards the AuthFlowOut.kt and the BrowserAllowlist. The only browser I have installed is fennec, which is not in the allowlist.

I could fix it myself removing the browser checks from the code - then the system defaults browser is used and no more crashes.

What I have changed:

File AuthFlowOut.kt (Line 51):
```
    val authService: AuthorizationService =
        AuthorizationService(
            context, AppAuthConfiguration.Builder()
                // .setBrowserMatcher(
                //     BrowserAllowList(
                //         VersionedBrowserMatcher.CHROME_CUSTOM_TAB,
                //         VersionedBrowserMatcher.FIREFOX_CUSTOM_TAB,
                //         VersionedBrowserMatcher.SAMSUNG_CUSTOM_TAB
                //     )
                // )
                .build()
        )
```

comments.body:
I also had trouble launching the new AAPS version. I use Edge as my default browser, so Chrome was probably in deep sleep.

First, I reinstalled version 3.3.2.0 and disabled Tidepool sync; after that, version 3.4.0.0 launched without any issues. Later, when I manually opened Chrome and enabled Tidepool sync, the login screen popped up in Chrome correctly.

(Samsung S24 SM-S9210, Android 16)
This cannot be affected by AAPS. Browser must support procession OAUTH2 requests and proper callback. AAPS is usig default browser in system.
